entries.en: You fucked up my hand! Two fingers ain't workin'! I want my money back!
entries.ro: Mi-ai futut mâna! Două degete nu mai merg! Vreau banii înapoi!

entries.en: You just finished fifteen minutes ago!
entries.ro: Abia ai terminat acum un sfert de oră!

entries.en: Well, yeah, but that's not the point!
entries.ro: Păi, da, da' nu despre asta e vorba!
Clientul ăsta te bate la cap?

entries.en: No, no. He was just thanking me for my excellent work, hm?
entries.ro: Nu, nu. Doar mă felicita pentru treaba bună, hm?
